changes.problem: Go1.27.1 trimpath omits ldflags from buildinfo; v4 declaration-text gate cannot succeed
changes.correction: Require actual 3 Go string headers/backing bytes through bounded Mach-O inspection. Retain original buildinfo version/module/CGO/architecture/trimpath/noVCS gates.

changes.problem: bounded symbol count/string table alone permits repeated long symbol-name copies in macho.NewFile
changes.correction: Before NewFile, bound individual names to1024 bytes and aggregate copies including NUL to8MiB. Use uint64 undefined-symbol range; cap relocations and indirect symbols. Reject every duplicate (segment,section-name) pair.

changes.problem: buildinfo.ReadFile invokes macho.NewFile before previous placement of worker inspector
changes.correction: Bound Mach-O input and check worker actual strings before buildinfo.ReadFile; bound controller self input too. Controller scope is unstripped thin ARM64.

history_limit: Intermediate source pins and original test logs are retained metadata; only final full owned sources are copied in this bundle. Earlier native observer/v4 source files were not modified.
unchanged_science: Native frozen vectors, inputs, candidate counts, Wants/order and labels unchanged; no new observed semantics or training labels.
